online_shoppers.title: Online Shoppers Purchasing Intention Dataset
online_shoppers.original: 12330 e-commerce sessions; real anonymized behavioral data
online_shoppers.limitation: Only prespecified six predictors; PageValues excluded as possible transaction outcome proxy; 1600 fixed stratified sampled sessions.

ai4i_maintenance.title: AI4I 2020 Predictive Maintenance Dataset
ai4i_maintenance.original: 10000 synthetic industrial equipment observations (NOT real factory incidents)
ai4i_maintenance.limitation: Only 6 legitimate features; removed device identifiers and all 5 specific failure-target columns. Stratified random 80/20 may overestimate temporally deployed performance.

warnings: Four seeds, NOT 42; cannot establish robust cross-dataset superiority
Public dataset is CAPPED and uses SIX prespecified features; not full source-data performance
AI4I machine failures are synthetic, not observed industry incidents
Data are stratified into train/test; external deployment can have temporal or distribution shift
No Match means majority-class fallback under baseline, not actual abstention
Class imbalance: report minority recall and Balanced Accuracy, not accuracy alone
All training preprocessing/reduct/rules done on training-only, test held out
